subject: executor: introduce tagged pointer in hash join v2 (#55470)
summary: Adds MSB-tagged `uintptr` (`taggedPtr`) plus a `tagPtrHelper` mask derived from build-side row pointer leading-zeros; uses it to embed an OR-accumulated hash-tag in hash-bucket head/next pointers to early-reject lookups and short-circuit collision-chain traversal in hash join v2. Reviewed build/probe call paths and later history for this area; no remaining correctness/semantics/concurrency Blocker/High issues found.
